Thought of the day: People who are closed become invisible. People who are open are truly seen. 

Greetings from my bathroom. Been awhile since I’ve been on here. Life’s been amazing.

I haven’t been posting on the social media web2 much lately but here’s my diary. Woke up at 5am and worked out first thing. It’s part of a new habit I picked up. It was cold and I didn’t want to but I did it anyway and that was a small victory. After that I did my rituals and then meditated listening to Temple Mind. I love Phil’s meditation music. A vivid memory came to me of my father carrying me around as an infant. In the memory I was crying because I was confused. Maybe because I was new to earth and I couldn’t do much because now I was a baby. Maybe I was used to being an infinity beam of light capable of anything. Idk. But my father took me out under the stars and I remember looking up at the heavens and I felt home again. I could hear the distant crashing waves of the ocean and feel the cold air on my cheeks. And most of all I could feel my father’s love for me and I knew that everything was going to be okay. Then I went to sleep. It’s wild the deep memories stored in our subconscious. They are always there. We are living and embodying them. Some beautiful like this. Some painful and often unseen. After that I hung out in web3 for a while. We’re about to see the new Renaissance in art and I feel blessed to be here and blessed to be creating what we are with Josh and Matt and Jon and Dan and the whole Cthdrl team. I went to the studio and worked on some interludes then painted because I used to love to paint as a kid. I read for an hour or so and practiced scales on the piano. I’m understanding music more the more I understand my self. I went on a hike later and Ash drove by while I was climbing up a hill with my 5sos merch headphones because I’m a super fan. Then I watched the sunset. After that I took a swim in the icy cold pool. Of course with my pink goggles. It hurt. But the jacuzzi felt good after. Now I’m guna make a pizza and probably listen to ABBA. Maybe Miles Davis. Idk. Seems like I did a lot when I write it but the days keep feeling shorter. I’m still trying to be like the sun. Diary - El Roy

Haven’t posted on
Here on a while. Letting a lot of things go as we enter the meta verse. Updates, I’ve been getting up at 5am working out and meditating before starting my days. I’ve been in communication with a family of deer on the top of my secret spot in LA. There’s 7 of them. 3 babies. They say hi. I saved one from getting hit by a car. They trust me now so they hang out with me while I watch the sunset a lot of days. I’ve been creating structures to flow in and theres so much music and beyond I am looking forward to sharing through Jagwar Twin in 2022. Most of my life I’ve felt either too far ahead or behind. Things have never felt more here. I would share more but I’ll just have to show you next year the world me and the team have been building for so many months. I hang out more in the Jagwar Twin Discord these days so feel free to drop in and hang out and talk. We have awesome humans and awesome conversations in there. Here’s some content 🐆 - Roy

Yesterday I woke up early and drove to the beach with my dad to watch my nephews while my brother and sister setup for Sam’s first birthday. 
It’s difficult to be present when I’m tired. I observed that. Then we took the kids to the party on the beach with my family. It was really nice. I went swimming with Luke and ate a bunch of lemon cookies and talked with my cousins. Most of the family and friends in my life are married or have kids. I’m looking at a different reflection. I think I have some sort of strange musical baby in its infant stages instead of a human child or partner. My cousin got her car stuck in the sand and my brother dug her out. He’s good at stuff like that. I did nothing but held babies and stuff.  After the beach I went home and went on a hike and meditated looking over the city. Then I went in the studio and received some amazing words and melodies and sang it over a beat that S1 sent me. I paused and ate dinner and Cal made one of the best carrot cakes I’ve ever tasted from scratch. No lie. Cals a baking legend baking cakes and stuff. Then I meditated and went to bed. - diary

Yesterday I woke up at sunrise on my parents couch to my nephew William running around the kitchen. William wanted to play. He’s 3. So we played with trains. After that my mom and dad and I ate breakfast with the kids and then we took them to go on a train ride. After that we went for a picnic in the park and then to the zoo. I felt kind of sad looking at the animals in the cages. In some ways that’s how it is to be a human trapped in a body in unconscious patterns of lower animalistic impulses. Anyway, after the zoo we went home and made pizzas and played in the backyard. It was fun. My parents are awesome.  Kids are tiring. I don’t know how my brother and his wife do it. Shoutout to the parents out there. I’m blessed to have great ones. When I left I told William I loved him and he said I love you so much and gave me a hug. They sure can make your heart melt. Then I drove home and meditated and slept. - diary of Roy 1534

Yesterday I woke up, did my morning rituals and meditated. After that had lunch with my mom and her pastor friend Joel at a French restaurant. We had interesting conversations. He talked about God like music and I think that’s a good way to see God. He played saxophone. I ate banana and Nutella crepes. I’ve been feeling tired lately and I’m not sure why. Maybe I’ve been feeling restless about if Jagwar Twin is ever really going to “happen”. Sometimes I feel like if more people could just hear the music, I know they would love it. Sometimes I feel like maybe l’m not really that good and I’m like an insane person who everybody’s looking at like, yo when are you going to give this up? But I know that second voice is not my true voice. It’s kind of like there are two people inside of me. Maybe more than that. Maybe it’s as many people as there are outside of me. Sometimes I have no doubts and I feel like I Know Jagwar Twin is going to be one of the biggest bands in the world to be used for the good of the world. And sometimes I wana run away from it all and come up with an excuse why it would have never worked anyway. Maybe live in the wilderness alone. This is a tangent but I promised myself I would always tell the truth and that’s how I feel I I’m writing this. I don’t know everything and i certainly don’t know nothing. Later that night I met up with Alex and Jo and then we went to dinner with Khalifa and his friends. There was a lot of food. He had his favorite burgers delivered from another restaurant to the restaurant we were eating at. We ended up at country night at Poppy. They didn’t play much country but I found a cowboy hat and Alex, Jo, Khalifa and I wore matching white outfits like the Backstreet Boys in 2001. They played a song I did with Alesso called Cool in the club and I sang along. And I danced like a kid and smiled a lot. It’s good to be with friends and humans who see you for who you are. It’s a reminder to keep going. If a few people really see you, you’re doing something right. Now you just gotta let everyone else see you. Here’s my diary and reminder to myself for the day to keep going. -Roy

Yesterday I woke up and went on a hike/run and listened to a lecture by Neville Goddard. Most of my life I told myself I “hated working out”. Now I love it. Maybe hate and love are really two sides of the same coin. After that I had a zoom meeting and my manager said Jagwar Twin streams were up 945 percent in Japan so that was cool. After that I meditated and then wrote down what i received in meditation. After that I went to the dry cleaners and got gas and then answered emails for a couple hours and I actually enjoyed doing it. I had been putting some of them off because I told myself I don’t like doing emails. What we tell ourselves really does become the reality we inhabit. After emails I made dinner and then watched the Green Lantern. It was a good documentary. I took notes and paused it many times. Then I showered, meditated and went to bed. Here’s a selfie of me remembering to clean the toothpaste off my mirror - End/Beginning of Diary 🌍🐆

Yesterday I woke up and went on a run to watch the sunrise over LA. After that I meditated by the fireplace then journaled and wrote down the things I desire to see in 2021. I know who I am is much more than I have in the past. It’s beautiful how twisted up and backwards I’ve been at times in my life. It seems like a roller coaster where you get so turned around but it’s part of the ride, and then you get off the ride and you’re like WOW I WAS TWISTED UP, and backwards, and upside down! And it gave you perspective on where you are now. How far you’ve come. And that’s been cool to see in so many human spirits this year. It feels like a great awakening. After that I prepared a New Year breakfast for me and cal, ate that, and then made music till dinner time. I made a pizza, watched The Dark Crystal on Netflix and ate the pizza , and then went to bed. - Happy New Year. We got this. - diary of El Roy the Jagwar

Yesterday I woke up from a dream and heard a song. I voice noted it on my phone and wrote down the lyrics for later. Then Rachel came over and she led us in morning yoga. She’s so cool and her music is called Little Luna and its awesome. After that I meditated and then read for a while. Then I made breakfast. After that I  answered emails and talked on the phone with Josh. Then I went in the studio, made a beat and recorded the song from my dream over some beautiful, stream of consciousness, chaotic guitar music that Matt had sent me the day before. It was really fun to let things flow and get out of the way of my head to a childlike state of creation and joy. Right when I finished recording Josh called me and said that the Happy Face experiment was going live in 5 minutes. So I packed my stuff up and then started talking to people on the web about their experiences. I love talking to other-selves. Even on the spider web. We are all connected. This Happy Face experiment is only a current reality, although a virtual one, but who’s to say that’s any less real, because of the collective of brilliant developing minds involved and their willingness to push past preconceptions of what is possible. Happy Face comes out 12/11/2020 and it is just the beginning of the experiment. I’m excited to watch it unfold as more portals are discovered. In the meantime, I am content. - Diary of Roy

Yesterday I woke up and worked out in the backyard. After that I meditated by the fire. After that I made a Mayan hot chocolate, ate some fruit and toast and read a book. Then ryan came over and we set up a makeshift film studio and filmed a music video for a new Jagwar Twin song. It was really fun. I’m blessed to know and grow with my brother ryan. We met a long time ago on a photo shoot we were modeling for. The vibe was weird and we both didn’t really like modeling but for some reason we agreed to do the job and that’s where we met. Now he’s behind the camera, and I guess I’m in front of the camera still sometimes but as an artist and it feels much different now. I was always so insecure about the way I looked. Maybe it started with things people said to me growing up, maybe it was a thoughtform passed down my family line, but regardless, I was the one who believed the thoughts and internalized them. Carl Jung said 
“the shadow has roots that go all the way to hell.” And I believe that to be true. Mankind is like an in between. Animating the forces of Heaven and Hell. So let’s create more of what we want to see on earth. That starts inside. Here’s some content. It’s a picture of me on my street. Adoni 🌍🕊- El Roy

Happy human birth Mi Hawk. You are a beam of light. You make people feel seen and loved and inspire the inner child in everyone around you. This is going to be a beautiful, expanding, and creative year for you. But you already know that 🌞🧬. I hope you feel as special today as you made me feel on my birthday when this picture was taken. Love you - Roy

Yesterday I woke up and went on a run. After that I meditated and then packed my bag for Joshua Tree then I picked up Aubrey and went to get a Covid test. I didn’t think I had it but I was going to be around some people so I wanted to make sure. I was negative. So that’s good. After that I went home and are some toast and strawberries. Then Rachel came over and Rachel and Aubrey and I got in my car and drove out to the desert to celebrate Ashtons album release. I love driving out to the desert with friends and the conversations along the way. When we got to the desert the sun was setting and the rest of the group pulled up. Rachel led us all through a guided meditation as the sun was going down. When we opened our eyes it was night. We ate amazing food and desert, had life giving and receiving conversations, went in the jacuzzi under the stars. I looked up at the stars for a very long time and started to see each star as an electrical synapse firing like in the brain of the creator. Ashton is such an amazing creator, leader and guide and allows others to see into their own unique creative process with a shared goal in mind. Superbloom is a master piece and the creative team he has surrounded himself with are all each masters as well. Matt, Gianni, Ryan, Julian, Tosh, I know there’s so many more but so many beautiful humans all creating beautiful art. Ash, may you continue to bless the world through your lens and continue to create Space. In the metaphorical sense and in the cosmic sense. We are all creators, points of light, like electrical synapses of truth firing, or like stars in the mind of God and all creation comes from Space. Ash, are a star ⭐️. Love - Roy

Yesterday I woke up and went on a sunrise hike with andrew and talked about life and moths and the universe and each of our purposes. Everyone has a purpose and the more you begin to know who you are the more you know that purpose. No one is here without a purpose. That is something I know. After that I meditated and read a book on light and then sat down to make music. I love making music. I did that for quite a while and then I answered emails and started going through the rest of the year through next years plan. I never used to plan. 2020 is really the first year I have worked on purposefully planning behind a purpose. Josh has helped me very much with that even tho we butt heads at times because we are coming at the same problem from two opposite ends but we always get to something beautiful because we have the same goal and a mutual love and respect for each other and the world around us. When it got dark I started getting a shot list together for a video for the next song coming out. Aubrey just got home from being in Portland for 4 months so I’m happy about that although I didn’t see her yesterday because I had much to do and create but I will see her today. It’s beautiful that when you are whole in yourself you don’t need another person to validate you and that’s something I find so attractive about Aubrey. She knows herself and loves herself so she doesn’t need me, but that makes it even more awesome when we are together. I got ready for bed around 8:30, meditated and then went off to learn things in my dreams. Here’s a picture of Aubrey and I cooking. And by Aubrey and I, I mean I was supervising, looking over her shoulder saying funny things,  and probably doing the dishes. I’m a good cook too. At least I like to think so but people say my food is very “natural”. I will take that as a compliment. - end/beginning of a diary of a loser/winner

Yesterday I woke up and did Chi Do and then went on a run up through the hills listening to Peter Gabriel to watch the sun rise over the valley. I could see Hogwarts castle off in the distance. Sometimes I feel like we’re really living that story. Harry Potter. There are forces of darkness that wish to consume us and we are connected to them in some strange way, but as we become more selfless, tell the truth, be brave with that truth, and live from a place of love help will always find us. Love always wins. We’ve heard it in every great story and all the ancient myths. Love conquers all. I believe that to be true. Maybe we have lost some of what love means, but maybe we’re waking up to that meaning again now. If we are living the Harry Potter story, which character are you? And which character do you want to be? After that I went home and we had our weekly Jagwar Twin Zoom meditation and Q&A. We talked about free will and destiny and death. After that I had some phone calls, worked with josh on planning the next year of song releases and answered emails. Then I went to the grocery store. After that I cooked dinner and watched the beginning of The Lion King. Then I went in the studio and made music till late at night. Well late for me anyway. Then I meditated and went to bed so I could get some answers from my dreams. Here’s a picture Pete took of me driving a rented mini van in Seattle. - end/beginning of a diary of loser/winner 🌍🕊 Roy

Yesterday I woke up in Ithaca and meditated in the woods. I was in upstate NY for a little over a week in the staying at joshes house. I learned how to play golf while I was there. Kind of. I hiked a lot and saw a lot of waterfalls. I also played a lot of Uno with Grey, Maven and Arrow. Arrow who’s 7 and Maven who’s 5 loved to mediate so they started to join me. I would take us to space, or back in time to see dinosaurs, or to candy castles with rainbow unicorns. Wherever they wanted to go we would go. Yesterday before I left, Arrow wanted to meditate in a tree. So he climbed up and we started meditating. About 10 minutes in he fell out of the tree and got really hurt. I picked him up and carried him out of the woods. 7 year olds are a lot heavier than I thought they were. Maybe I shouldn’t have let him meditate in a tree. I don’t know. Kids are cool tho. They can create worlds in their imagination much easier than we can. Imagination is the language of God. All creation starts in the imagination so it’s important to reconnect to that. After getting back to the house Arrow was Ok. Then josh took me to the airport. On the flight I read a book, watched the Secret Life of Walter Mitty and worked on some music. When I landed I got a Lyft back home to Duke and Cal. It is very nice to be home now as I write this. It will be a beautiful year. Josh took this picture with one of those super long nature photographer camera lenses while I was in the woods. A Jagwar in the wild - End/Beginning of a diary of a Loser/Winner 🌍🕊 El Roy

Yesterday i woke up and did chi do. Then I went on a run through the hills. After that I meditated and then recorded some vocals. Then I talked to josh on the phone. After that I went over to Ashtons house to make music with Matt. Matt is a force in this world. Jagwar Twin would not be what it is without him believing in it and seeing me very early on. Definitely before I saw myself. Creating with Matt is such an amazing process. We have almost the opposite taste in music and approach music from completely different focus points. We almost always disagree on things when writing. But there is a knowing that the other self’s opinion and feelings are valued and respected. Everyone can be a genius you just have to be it in your own way. This is why we create amazing things together. There is so much push and pull but we know if we BOTH like something it must be really amazing. It’s a good reminder to always tell the truth. Even when it makes things harder. What if the more truthful you were with yourself and the world around you was the metric for how successful you would become? It’s not necessarily what is taught in school, but the signs seem to indicate a correlation. And maybe a person’s access to the truth depends upon one’s focus on Love. Again, the correlation seems to be there. After studio I went home and watched Maniac on Netflix then went to bed. Here’s a selfie - End/Beginning of a diary of a Loser/Winner.

Yesterday I woke up at 4:15 and did Chi Do. Then I meditated. After that I wrote verses to a new song I really like. My mom asked me to bring N64 over so she could play Legend Of Zelda so I did. We went to dinner first and then we played Ocarina Of Time. My mom mostly fished and rode Epona. I always loved that game as a kid and I see why now. I went through a phase where I didn’t like games. Of any kind. But I’m seeing more that playing games is really important. You can make everything a game. Even washing the dishes or going somewhere you don’t want to go. Games are like meditation in a lot of ways and who knows, maybe this whole world is just one giant game we’re living in. That seems to be the direction science is pointing towards. But that doesn’t make it any less real. The experience you have here is real. And purposeful. If you know it’s a game would you play life any differently than you are now? I love this photo and both people in it so much. Michael loves games and made me love playing games when we lived together. He always plays fair and helps you even when it makes him lose. But it’s because he knows it’s just a game so losing isn’t losing. You just get to start another game. I wana live like that. And Aubrey is a gamer in a different way. She makes games out of living and plays characters and does weird dances and sings broadway. I think that’s a good game. You can be anything you want in your game. Everyone’s playing.

Yesterday I woke up and did Chi-Do. After that I made some hot chocolate and read a book and then meditated. After that I made some beautiful music with Michael and we also talked about things we have both been learning. Creating anything is just telling the truth. And maybe the more you tell the truth, from your unique perspective as a point of consciousness of One body of consciousness, the more truth will be felt. Creating is really just another way for you to know who you are. I’ve found that a lot of times in the past I have created from a place of thinking “I hope people like this.” Maybe it’s the “public” maybe management, or a record label, but that isn’t creating from a place of love. At least not in the way that I understand it. I use the word understand very loosely here. Anyway, creating was fun. I’m remembering what it was like to do stuff as a kid. We used to make up worlds in our heads! Well we still can. Whose to say those worlds we create don’t exists somewhere in the multiverse. Maybe Imagination is the language of God. Most of the time I use English to communicate. After studio I went home and made dinner and watched a documentary. Then I went to bed. End/Beginning of a Diary of a loser/winner

Yesterday I woke up and did Chi-Do. Then I worked out and then meditated. My meditation felt like a lifetime but also like a moment and I leaned that all reality is, is that it is. After that I made breakfast and then went to the beach with Michael, Crystal, and Cal. I love swimming in the ocean. There were dolphins swimming and jumping. I love dolphins. I used to dream about them often as a kid and I believed I could talk with them. Maybe I can, but I haven’t yet. After that, michael, cal, and I played a game called Villains while listening to Disney songs. I won playing as Maleficent but winning in the context of evil is the same as losing so I also lost. Then we had a pizza making contest. The winner of that is also up for debate, but my vote goes to cal for the most honest pizza. The sweetest pizza award, indisputably, goes to michael. After pizza I went home and went to bed. Here’s a selfie where I look mad but I am not. - end/beginning of a diary of Loser/Winner

Yesterday I woke up and did Chi-Do.
After that I meditated. It was day 6 fasting but I ate some fruit at night and a hibiscus flower. After meditating I skateboarded and talked to Joel and Gianni. Then I answered emails. Cal was swimming and that made me want to swim so I did. I swam around the pool with some pink goggles I bought on amazon. Goggles are fun. Then we rescued a Japanese Beetle from the water but he died later. After that I took an online class and then Andrew and Racheal came over for a little and we talked about music and moths. After that I finished my online class, answered emails, then played drums then watched a wrinkle in time. That was one of my favorite books as a kid and I have learned many lessons from it. Mostly about time travel and the micro/ and macro cosmos working in the same way inside your body and the rest of the universe. The gateway is ones heart. It’s always in the movies, but it took me a long time to figure out how to open my own heart and remember who I was. After that I meditated and then went to bed. It was a good day. - diary of a ____

Yesterday I woke up, started a fire and did chi do. It started raining but it was warm outside. After chi do I meditated in the rain. It was day 4 of fasting. After meditation I went on a hike around the hills and listened to @radvxz. Then I went skateboarding and talked to josh on the phone. After that I met up with Michael and Luke at the studio. It was really fun. Luke did an awesome guitar solo and michael and I drank cacao husk water. We also talked about geometry and where the world is going. Everyone says that accidents happen, and maybe they do, but if this is truly a quantum universe then there are no such thing as accidents. Only possibilities and probabilities folded into existence by perception. Where do your perceptions come from? After studio I made more music, talked to my brother, then meditated and went to bed. Here’s a selfie - diary of a loser

Yesterday I woke up and meditated. Meditating is kind of like taking your blindfold off. I remember more when I meditate. Sometimes things I forgot a very long time ago. It was day two of fasting except I ate some shilajit tar in the morning. I just got home from spending a couple weeks in the woods in central Oregon under the stars with the full moon. I got some new rocks. It’s always nice to come home. I had a call with my managers and that was nice. After that I made some music. Then after that I went on a hike and talked to my neighbor. After that I made some more music and then watched a documentary on  A.I. Merging with humans. It brings up many questions and in some ways we already have merged with technology without fully knowing that we are doing it. I am holding a device currently transmitting 1’s and 0’s that you are reading and something labeled “content”. Are you content? Here’s a selfie - diary of a loser

Yesterday I woke up and played tennis. I’m pretty good at tennis. I learned everything I know from Mario Tennis for N64. After tennis I rode my bike around. After that I meditated for a while and then answered emails. Then I made some music. The new music I’m creating brings me so much joy. I am looking forward to sharing it all. I have been able to say things I’ve never been able to articulate in music before.  I am speaking less but I am saying more. Silence makes some uncomfortable but I enjoy the gaps. After making music for a while I ate dinner at sunset and then watched Jurassic Park and made peanut butter cookies. After that I went to bed. Here’s a picture of me wearing a yellow bowling shirt I found at a thrift store. - Diary of a Loser

Yesterday I woke up and rode my bike around the neighborhood listening to Coldplay. It was cloudy. After that I meditated in the garden for a while with Potato Chip until Josh called and brought me back. We talked for a while about stuff I needed to do and then I did some stuff and answered emails. Then talked on the phone with Joe. Then I got back home and did laundry and then went on a hike up the hills with Andrew and we talked about life. Then Andrew and I worked on a project with moths. After that I ate dinner and then watched some documentaries. Then I read a book and went to sleep. It was a good day. - diary of a loser

Yesterday I woke up and did Chi Do. After that Philipp and I got on zoom and did our weekly Tuesday Jagwar Twin meditation. We talked about oneness and what that implies if we are in a dream in the mind of God. We talked about the possibility of time being a program and how to follow your dreams. It was a good one. After that I went to Sunset Sound with Joe and recorded vocals for a new song. We got into a deep discussion on purpose and why we even started to make music in the first place. I’ve learned if youre not telling the truth in your creations there’s no reason for you to create them. Unless of course the intent is to deceive. We’ve seen how that plays out in our world today as much is continuing to come to the surface. But it is good. The shift has happened in human consciousness and it’s beautiful to see in so many of the conversations I’ve been having with people on the internet (assuming you are real people,  which I have very little physical evidence of, however believe it to be true). Anyway, Singing was really fun. After that I went home and sat in the backyard with Cal and talked. Then I made dinner and watched Avatar:The last airbender. Has anyone else actually tried to water bend? I could use some tips. I went to bed early reading a book that appeared on my couch. No one knows where it came from but it is very interesting. This is a weird diary entry haha- diary of a loser

Yesterday I woke up and meditated. Right when I finished Ryan called and he was just meditating too. We talked for awhile about things we’re learning inside of ourselves. I feel like I’ve know Ryan forever. Maybe I have. Then I read for a while about mythology. After that I went inside and made music. It was so much fun. I’ve been in a good creative flow and it’s been teaching me more and more who I am. After creating I stopped for a little to eat and watch a documentary on ancient civilizations with @matiasgustavodestefano after that I was inspired so I created more music. Yesterday I woke up and mediated. I haven’t been active on social media for a while because there was and is much internal work to be done. We are co-creating this world we are in at the moment and there is only one moment, one time, one space, one eternal now. We are the thinking of the planet. Like conscious neurons. 
The only one evolving is the planet.
Many of us are asking difficult questions. And that’s important.
Truth is like a sphere.
You can’t see the whole thing.
You are meant to hold your own unique perspective.
And if you don’t live out of your own perspective then one of the parts of the sphere goes missing. We need you  here 🌍
The goal Is not to go out to the stars but into the core of the sphere - planet / self - macro/ micro - so u can see every perspective from one spot.
I guess this isn’t a really a diary just some thoughts. - diary of a loser

Yesterday I woke up late and realized our weekly meditation was about to start. So I got my computer and joined. It was so amazing. We had over 400 people registered this week and it has been so beautiful to see our little community growing. I think we had maybe 30 people the first week right after quarantine started. I love meeting people and talking about life on Zoom in our Q&As after and being able to remind others how uniquely amazing they are. I had to see it in myself first and I do now. There were many years of me trying to be other people without being aware that i was doing so. Anyways. After that I talked I had a zoom meeting with josh and Greg and then I filmed a live performance for a new cover with Luke. After that I made some more music and then talked to some people online while watching The Emperors New Groove. I like that movie. I’m happy to be on earth at this time. And happy you are all here too. We. Us. I. You. It’s all one thing. Later I watched a spirit science video on frozen 2 and then went to bed. - diary of a loser

Yesterday I woke up and did a short meditation. Then I drove to go pick up a present in Playa Del Rey. I listened to an amazing talk from a Shaolin Monk on the way. It was nice to see the beach and I really like Playa Del Rey. When I got home I meditated again and then played basketball. Then I talked to Ash and Michael and Cal for a little. After that I went on IG live with Alessandra to talk about mental health and other things with Deepak Chopra. The theme was you are never alone. And I believe that to be true. I am always with myself. I am everywhere I am. So who I am is the big question. And with that question you start to see your self in everyone and everything.  You see the beauty and recognize the darkness, both with a loving embrace. Or something like that. Don’t take my word for it cause I don’t know. After the talk I realized more that just being me was enough to be anything I wanted to be. It was a good day. - diary of a loser
